tools.name: logout
tools.description: Log out the current Jiji mobile session. Clears auth cookies; run before login when switching accounts.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to Jiji Nigeria with email and password (mobile API). Returns session cookies for authenticated pipelines.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Auth probe and profile summary — GET profile/info scope account_info. Run before authenticated flows.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full Jiji keyword search (suggest → auto category slug → listings). Preferred for product search. Pass user keyword as term and query (same value). Never pass slug=all.

tools.name: search_suggest
tools.description: Jiji suggest only (step 37). Prefer the combined search pipeline unless debugging.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Listings only after search_suggest. Slug auto-resolved via step 200 — never pass slug=all (404 when logged in).

tools.name: browse_listings
tools.description: Browse Jiji category listing results (mobile phones category from recon). Optional query override.

tools.name: search_next_page
tools.description: Fetch the next Jiji ads_listing page using opaque next_url from the prior search (Nova LD pagination).

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List Jiji regions (areas) for Leads Discovery pickers.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Jiji marketplace categories for Leads Discovery pickers.

tools.name: view_listing_detail
tools.description: Fetch Jiji listing detail fields for one advert (form_fields API). Pass advert id from search results.

tools.name: show_vendor_contact
tools.description: Fetch seller phone numbers for a Jiji chat thread. Requires room_id from list_messages (run inbox first). Returns other_user_phone and other_user_phones.

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Send the first message to a seller about a listing — opens a new Jiji chat thread. Use after search_suggest with listing ids.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List the signed-in user's Jiji message inbox (all chat threads with seller, advert title, and last message preview). Requires login.

tools.name: view_chat_thread
tools.description: Read full message history for one chat thread (GET). Use after list_messages when the user picks a vendor thread.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Send a reply in an existing Jiji chat thread. Use after list_messages with advert id and seller user_id from the chosen thread.

tools.name: view_listing_advert
tools.description: Fetch full Jiji advert JSON (api/v1/advert/{id}.json). Prefer over form_fields when listing id is valid.

tools.name: view_listing_v2
tools.description: Fetch Jiji advert via api/v2/advert/{id} (mobile app detail route).

tools.name: list_job_applicants
tools.description: List CV applicants on YOUR job vacancy (auth). job_cvs API — only for job adverts you own.

tools.name: list_potential_clients
tools.description: List potential buyers/leads on YOUR goods advert (seller auth).

tools.name: list_seller_opinions
tools.description: Seller reputation opinions (not listing comments). Pass u{user_id}.json from search seller id.

tools.name: list_saved_ads
tools.description: List saved/favorite ads for the signed-in Jiji user.

tools.name: list_my_ads
tools.description: List active ads posted by the signed-in Jiji seller account.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "logout" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Log out the current Jiji mobile session. Clears auth cookies; run before login when switching accounts.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login" references sensitive artifacts (password, cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Log in to Jiji Nigeria with email and password (mobile API). Returns session cookies for authenticated pipelines.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-bgpt-jiji-recon" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: show_vendor_contact, list_messages, view_chat_thread, list_seller_opinions · Private data: login, show_vendor_contact · Public sink: login, start_chat, send_reply · Destructive: logout, account_info, show_vendor_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: show_vendor_contact, list_messages, view_chat_thread, list_seller_opinions · Private data: login, show_vendor_contact · Public sink: login, start_chat, send_reply · Destructive: logout, account_info, show_vendor_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
